model: Apex / Arctic with Concert or Panasonic 4716 software (Universal Gateway)
applies_to: Thermal Solutions Apex and Arctic boilers with the Concert control and display, and Apex boilers with the Panasonic display running 4716 software, through the Universal Gateway.
summary: Apex and Arctic boilers on 4716 software (Concert control, or Apex with the Panasonic display) are read over Modbus RTU by the Thermal Solutions Universal Gateway (a ProtoNode) and served as BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP devices. The 45-object profile adds BMS demand, setpoint, outdoor temperature and firing-rate commands that must be refreshed within a Modbus command timeout, plus pump status, low-temperature loop values, burner state and lockout and hold codes.
default_device_instance: 50000 + boiler Modbus address (BACnet IP and MS/TP multiple node); Node_Offset default 50,000
notes: The Universal Gateway is a ProtoNode (BACnet RER FPC-N34-0816, LonWorks LER FPC-N35-0817) that auto-discovers up to 8 boilers on its Modbus RS-485 port.
Every boiler is its own BACnet device with the same object list; the instances here are for one boiler.
Power all boilers and connect them before running auto-discovery; a boiler added later is not found until discovery is run again.
On this list the local setpoints (AV 3-6) and Burner On Off (BV 1) are read only; BMS control goes through BV 29-30 and AV 31-34.
The manual lists BI 43 CH heat demand as W; it is a binary input and the matching Modbus register is read only, so it is recorded here as read only.
Apex and Arctic boilers with Concert can run their own lead lag sequencer and talk to the EMS at the same time.

integration.summary: Set a unique Comm HMI Station ID on each Concert display (Menu > EMS Interface > Modbus Setup), wire the boiler's EMS terminals to the gateway, run auto-discovery, then write a demand (BV 29 or BV 30) plus a setpoint (AV 31 or AV 32) or a firing rate (AV 34). Those values must be rewritten before the Modbus command timeout runs out (default 30 s) or the boiler falls back to local control.

minimum_points.name: CH Modbus Stat
minimum_points.why: CH demand from the BMS (1 = demand)

minimum_points.name: LLCH Modbus Stat
minimum_points.why: Lead lag CH demand from the BMS (1 = demand)

integration.enable: Write BV 29 CH Modbus Stat (single boiler) or BV 30 LLCH Modbus Stat (lead lag) = 1 for demand, with AV 31 CH Modbus SP or AV 32 CH Sequencer Modbus SP (60-190 °F). To drive the firing rate instead, write AV 34 CH Modbus Rate (0-200 gives 0-100 %).
integration.heartbeat: AV 36 Modbus command timeout (30-120 s, default 30). BV 29, BV 30, AV 31, AV 32 and AV 34 must be rewritten within that time; otherwise the demand drops to 0, setpoints return to the local setpoint and the firing rate returns to local control.
integration.remote_sensors: AV 33 Outdoor Temperature (-40 to 302 °F) can be written by the BMS. If it is not rewritten within the Modbus command timeout the value is flagged bad and outdoor reset falls back to the local setpoint.
setup: BACnet IP and MS/TP multiple node: each boiler is its own device, instance = Node_Offset (default 50,000) + boiler Modbus address, so address 1 = 50001.
BACnet MS/TP single node (for front ends without virtual-node support): one device at Node_Offset + MAC, with boiler objects renumbered 1001, 1002... for address 1, 2001... for address 2.

S-bank DIP switches pick the protocol (S0-S2 all Off = BACnet IP, S0 On = MS/TP multiple node, S2 On = MS/TP single node); S3 On at power-up runs auto-discovery (about 3 minutes), then set S3 Off to keep the configuration.
MS/TP MAC address 1-127 on A-bank DIP switches (one MAC for the whole gateway); baud rate on B-bank switches.
Change the IP address and Node_Offset in the ProtoNode web configurator (default IP 192.168.1.24).
Concert display: Menu > EMS Interface > Modbus Setup > EMS Modbus Parameter, set a unique Comm HMI Station ID for each boiler wired to the gateway.
gotchas: AV 34 CH Modbus Rate is scaled 0-200 for 0-100 % firing rate.
Write the counters (AV 24-28) and AV 36 only when a change is needed.
AI 19 is the commanded fan speed and AI 35 the measured fan speed.
Pump status codes 92-127 are listed in the manual's table 1.
